title: GoodCook Touch 8" Stainless Steel Wire Mesh Strainer with Non-slip Grip Handle
description:
About this item
8" DIAMETER MESH STRAINER: Great for a variety of kitchen tasks, from sifting dry ingredients, straining sauces and purees, and rinsing rice and beans, as well as washing smaller fruits, vegetables, and herbs
FINE MESH: Fine mesh catches smaller particles, scraps, and seeds allowing liquids to pass through, and its lightweight design can be left on top of bowls for hands-free gradual straining and draining
COMFORTABLE HANDLE: Sturdy, easy grip handle makes it easier to hold and keeps hands clean while in use
CONVENIENT EXTENDED LIP: Extended lip allows it to sit securely over the rims of bowls, containers, or the sink
MADE OF DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL: Stainless steel mesh is made to last, and the compact size makes for convenient storage on kitchen shelves and in cabinets

reviews_5s: I chose this strainer because I wanted something light, yet sturdy. This strainer meets both of those criteria. It is a nice size so that I can fit it over a medium or large saucepan and steam veggies. It also has a fairly fine mesh so is good for straining my homemade veggie stock. It is also easy to clean...just pop it on the top shelf of the dishwasher rack! I haven't used it for draining pasta as I prefer free standing strainers for that. So can't speak to how sturdy it would be for that.This handle has a sturdy, round feel that supports the strainer contents well. The strainer does the job. Happy we upgraded to this strainer.nice, smaller, fine strainer, which is just what i needed. the plastic handle and frame is very sturdy so i expect it to hold up and not crack...i suppose an all metal version would be assured of no breakage though. this one works for me, and was a 4 for 3 item, and good price. worth it IMO.After years of daily use, the handle eventually broke on the first one of these I bought. It earned its keep admirably since I steamed a fairly heavy basket of vegetables daily and tended to a bit vigorous in handling it. At first I couldn't locate this model on Amazon and bought a couple other strainers that were disappointing, either because of the shallow basket or the too-fine double mesh. Those, no doubt, were good for straining but not for dumping a lot of freshly steaming vegetables into and then giving them a good shake. The rubber handle and wide rim very good for my purposes as well (steaming vegetables).Buena marca del productoI'm hoping I've finally found one that won't rust. I've used for finding quinoa several times now. It works as expected.
